title: Health data handling
why: Health data carries a consent record that is not derivable from the product's own rules: who agreed, to what, and when they withdrew. The catalog's retention rule covers deletion, not the basis on which the data was held at all.

addRequirements.title: Every health record has a consent basis
addRequirements.statement: When personal health data is read or written, the application shall check a recorded consent that names its purpose and its withdrawal state, and refuse the operation once that consent is withdrawn.
addRequirements.failurePath: A record read after consent was withdrawn is a reportable breach, not a bug, and no later delete undoes the read.
acceptance: Given a subject who withdraws consent, when any reader requests their health record, then the request is refused with a stable code and the refusal is logged.
Given a record created before consent was recorded, when it is read, then the read fails closed and the gap is reported rather than tolerated.

addGates.statement: A withdrawal of consent makes subsequent reads of that subject's health data fail, proven by a test.
